author: The Infographics Show
description:
Ticketmaster, Live Nation, concert ticket fees, monopoly pricing, and hidden charges are finally being exposed, and the details are even worse than people imagined.

For years, fans thought expensive concert tickets were just “the new normal", but behind the scenes, Ticketmaster executives were allegedly mocking customers, laughing about overcharging them, and running a system designed to squeeze money out of fans at every possible step.
A federal jury just confirmed what millions suspected all along. The game was rigged.

From the hidden $1.72 monopoly fee and leaked Slack messages, to corporate intimidation, venue control, parking scams, and the secret “Flywheel” system that helped Live Nation dominate the entire live entertainment industry, this is the story of how one company quietly took over concerts in America.

title: Ticketmaster is Finally Getting What it Deserves
